summary: Hawthorn Bancshares filed an 8-K to announce its Q1 2026 earnings and a quarterly dividend. The filing reports net income of $6.8M ($0.98 EPS) and declares a $0.21/share cash dividend payable July 1, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change involved. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
